Name: SW_P9_PA_PF1_ThaneArrival_00
Text: [Station chime]

Name: SW_P9_PA_PF1_ThaneArrival_01
Text:
ANNOUNCER: Pravashanche laksh asu dya.
(Attention please, passengers.)

Name: SW_P9_PA_PF1_ThaneArrival_02
Text:
ANNOUNCER: Dadarhun Thanyala yenari local gaadi Thane sthanakachya platform kramank ekavar aali aahe.
(The local train from Dadar to Thane has arrived on platform number one of Thane station.)

Name: SW_P9_PA_PF1_ThaneArrival_03
Text:
ANNOUNCER: Utaranyasathi pravashanni krupaya darvajyajaval gardi karu naye.
(Passengers getting off, please do not crowd near the doors.)

Name: SW_P9_PA_PF1_ThaneArrival_04
Text:
ANNOUNCER: Platformvar utarlyanantar krupaya pravashanchya vahatukila adthala honar nahi yachi kalaji ghya.
(After getting off on the platform, please take care not to obstruct other passengers.)

Name: SW_P9_PA_PF1_ThaneArrival_05
Text:
ANNOUNCER: Dhanyavaad.
(Thank you.)

Name: SW_P9_PA_PF9_Epilogue_NoAiroli_00
Text: [Station chime]

Name: SW_P9_PA_PF9_Epilogue_NoAiroli_01
Text:
ANNOUNCER: Pravashanche laksh asu dya.
(Attention please, passengers.)

Name: SW_P9_PA_PF9_Epilogue_NoAiroli_02
Text:
ANNOUNCER: Vashikade jaanari local gaadi kahi kshanat platform kramank nauvar yenar aahe.
(The local train towards Vashi will arrive on platform number nine in a few moments.)

Name: SW_P9_PA_PF9_Epilogue_NoAiroli_03
Text:
ANNOUNCER: Ya gaadicha Airoli sthanakavar thamba nahi.
(This train does NOT stop at Airoli station.)

Name: SW_P9_PA_PF9_Epilogue_NoAiroli_04
Text:
ANNOUNCER: Dhanyavaad.
(Thank you.)

Name: SW_P9_VO_Chaiwala_Wake_01
Text:
CHAIWALA: Saheb... Saheb, utha!
(Sir... sir, wake up!)

Name: SW_P9_VO_Chaiwala_Wake_02
Text:
Thane aala.
(We've reached Thane.)

Name: SW_P9_VO_Chaiwala_Wake_03
Text:
Kuthe jaycha aahe tumhala?
(Where do you need to go?)

Name: SW_P9_VO_Chaiwala_Call_01
Text:
CHAIWALA: Chaha... garam chaha!
(Tea... hot tea!)

Name: SW_P9_NPC_SH_1_01
Text: KANCHANA: Ae chikne... ruk! Tujhe hi toh dhoondh rahi thi main!

Name: SW_P9_NPC_SH_2_01
Text: KANCHANA: Itni aasani se nahi jaane dungi tujhe...

Name: SW_P9_NPC_SH_3_01
Text: KANCHANA: Idhar aa... tere liye kuch rakha hai.

Name: SW_P9_NPC_SH_4_01
Text: KANCHANA: Pehchana nahi mujhe...? Main toh tujhe jaanti hoon!

Name: SW_P9_NPC_SH_5_01
Text: KANCHANA: Bhaag le... jitna bhaagna hai. Dekhti hoon kahaan tak jaata hai!
